# eBay Singapore

> > eBay Singapore is the local marketplace for buying and selling new and used goods across diverse product categories with secure account authentication.

eBay Singapore (ebay.com.sg) serves as the regional platform for Singapore's online marketplace, offering comprehensive category browsing and secure user authentication systems to protect buyers and sellers in the local e-commerce ecosystem.

## Shopping & Categories

- [Shop by Category | eBay](https://www.ebay.com.sg/n/all-categories): Browse all eBay product categories and departments

## Account Security & Authentication

- [Security Measure | eBay](http://signin.ebay.com.sg/): eBay security verification and user authentication checkpoint
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://signin.ebay.com.sg/ws/eBayISAPI.dll?SignIn&ru=https://www.ebay.com.sg/sh/ord): eBay order management sign-in security verification page
